item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=metrics+for+novelty+and+feasibility+in+autonomous+research+candidate+selection&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"Unifying AI-assisted scientific discovery around exploration, hypothesis generation, and testing\", \"abstract\": null, \"doi\": null, \"pmid\": \"PMC13674306\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13674306\", \"source\": \"PMC\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"PubMedCentral\", \"url\": \"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13674306/?tool=EBI\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"PubMedCentral\", \"url\": \"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13674306/pdf/?tool=EBI\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13674306\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13674306?pdf=render\"}]}}, {\"title\": \"AI-Driven Synthesis in Medicinal Chemistry: Integrating Large Language Models, Robotic Automation, and Sustainability Metrics to Accelerate Drug Discovery.\", \"abstract\": \"Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming synthetic chemistry from task-specific predictors into integrated platforms that unify retrosynthesis, reaction optimization, and closed-loop robotic automation. This review highlights how AI-assisted planning and robotic execution shorten cycle times, reduce step counts, and improve route sustainability in medicinal chemistry. Recent advances, including large language models (LLMs), template-free retrosynthesis, and Bayesian optimization, are evaluated alongside key limitations in dataset quality, reproducibility, and deployment costs. To ensure translational relevance, reproducible benchmarks such as step count, time-to-in vitro, and green metrics (E-factor, process mass intensity) are emphasized.
